name: agent-passport-mcp
description: Issue and independently verify AI-agent passports and signed AI-decision receipts using ML-DSA-65 (NIST FIPS 204). Verification works offline and needs no trust in the issuer.

settings.name: FractalAI web base URL
settings.description: Override the FractalAI web endpoint base. Defaults to https://fractalai.net.co.

settings.name: FractalAI RPC URL
settings.description: Override the FractalAI JSON-RPC node URL. Defaults to https://api.fractalai.net.co.

settings.name: Pinned receipt-signing public key
settings.description: Pin a specific base64 ML-DSA-65 receipt-signing public key instead of resolving it from the published key directory.
